newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-BEA Income rated outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-BEA Income rated outperform.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co Inc said Monday it initiated coverage of BEA Income Fund with a rating of outperform long term for income-oriented accounts with above-average risk tolerance.
--It said it believes the fund offers clients with above-average risk tolerance attractive monthly income with moderate capital appreciation potential.
--"The combination of high yield bonds and investment grade securities offers diversity among asset classes, while providing a very attractive current income stream," Gruntal noted in a report.
